166	/// Typed filter for creature or permanent targeting restrictions.
167	/// Used instead of stringly-typed filters for compile-time safety.
168	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
169	pub enum TargetFilter {
170	    /// No additional restriction beyond the base type.
171	    Any,
172	    /// Only creatures/permanents you control.
173	    YouControl,
174	    /// Only creatures/permanents you don't control.
175	    YouDontControl,
176	    /// Only nonblack creatures (Doom Blade).
177	    Nonblack,
178	    /// Only non-Vampire, non-Werewolf, non-Zombie (Victim of Night).
179	    NotSubtypes(Vec<String>),
180	    /// Only creatures with power >= N (Smite the Monstrous).
181	    PowerAtLeast(i32),
182	    /// Only attacking creatures (Rebuke).
183	    Attacking,
184	    /// Only noncreature permanents (Bramblecrush).
185	    Noncreature,
186	    /// Only permanents with specific card types (Naturalize: artifact or enchantment).
187	    HasCardType(Vec<CardType>),
188	    /// Only permanents with specific subtypes or card types (Urgent Exorcism: Spirit or enchantment).
189	    SubtypeOrCardType { subtypes: Vec<String>, card_types: Vec<CardType> },
190	    /// Only creatures with a specific subtype (Olivia Voldaren: target Vampire).
191	    HasSubtype(String),
192	    /// "Another" — excludes the source permanent from valid targets.
193	    Another,
194	    /// Only creatures with the same name as the source permanent (Evil Twin).
195	    SameNameAsSource,
196	}

198	impl std::fmt::Display for TargetFilter {
199	    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
200	        match self {
201	            TargetFilter::Any => write!(f, "any"),
202	            TargetFilter::YouControl => write!(f, "you control"),
203	            TargetFilter::YouDontControl => write!(f, "you don't control"),
204	            TargetFilter::Nonblack => write!(f, "nonblack"),
205	            TargetFilter::NotSubtypes(types) => write!(f, "non-{}", types.join("/")),
206	            TargetFilter::PowerAtLeast(n) => write!(f, "power {}+", n),
207	            TargetFilter::Attacking => write!(f, "attacking"),
208	            TargetFilter::Noncreature => write!(f, "noncreature"),
209	            TargetFilter::HasCardType(types) => {
210	                let names: Vec<&str> = types.iter().map(|t| match t {
211	                    CardType::Artifact => "artifact",
212	                    CardType::Enchantment => "enchantment",
213	                    CardType::Creature => "creature",
214	                    CardType::Instant => "instant",
215	                    CardType::Sorcery => "sorcery",
216	                    CardType::Land => "land",
217	                    CardType::Planeswalker => "planeswalker",
218	                }).collect();
219	                write!(f, "{}", names.join(" or "))
220	            }
221	            TargetFilter::HasSubtype(subtype) => write!(f, "{}", subtype),
222	            TargetFilter::Another => write!(f, "another"),
223	            TargetFilter::SameNameAsSource => write!(f, "with the same name"),
224	            TargetFilter::SubtypeOrCardType { subtypes, card_types } => {
225	                let mut parts: Vec<String> = subtypes.clone();
226	                for t in card_types {
227	                    parts.push(match t {
228	                        CardType::Enchantment => "enchantment".into(),
229	                        CardType::Artifact => "artifact".into(),
230	                        _ => format!("{:?}", t).to_lowercase(),
231	                    });
232	                }
233	                write!(f, "{}", parts.join(" or "))
234	            }
235	        }
236	    }
237	}

427	    /// Called when this spell resolves from the stack.
428	    /// `targets` contains the targets chosen at cast time.
429	    /// For permanents: default moves to battlefield.
430	    /// For instants/sorceries: override to apply effect.
431	    fn on_resolve(&self, state: &mut GameState, object_id: ObjectId, targets: &[Target], _registry: &CardRegistry) {
432	        let _ = targets; // default ignores targets
433	        // Default for permanents: move to battlefield.
434	        let card_data = self.card_data();
435	        if card_data.card_types.iter().any(|t| t.is_permanent()) {
436	            state.move_object(object_id, Zone::Battlefield);
437	            // If this is a planeswalker, set starting loyalty counters.
438	            if let Some(loyalty) = self.starting_loyalty() {
439	                // For X-cost planeswalkers, the x_value is already set on the object.
440	                let x = state.get_object(object_id).and_then(|o| o.x_value).unwrap_or(0);
441	                let total = if card_data.cost.as_ref().map(|c| c.symbols.iter().any(|s| matches!(s, crate::types::ManaSymbol::X))).unwrap_or(false) {
442	                    x
443	                } else {
444	                    loyalty
445	                };
446	                state.add_counters(object_id, crate::types::CounterType::Loyalty, total);
447	            }
448	        }
449	    }
450	}

452	/// Registry mapping CardIds to their behavior implementations.
453	pub struct CardRegistry {
454	    cards: HashMap<CardId, Box<dyn CardBehavior>>,
455	    next_id: u32,
456	    name_to_id: HashMap<String, CardId>,
457	}
458	
459	impl CardRegistry {
460	    pub fn new() -> Self {
461	        Self {
462	            cards: HashMap::new(),
463	            next_id: 1,
464	            name_to_id: HashMap::new(),
465	        }
466	    }
467	
468	    /// Register a card and return its assigned CardId.
469	    pub fn register(&mut self, card: Box<dyn CardBehavior>) -> CardId {
470	        let id = CardId(self.next_id);
471	        self.next_id += 1;
472	        let name = card.card_data().name.clone();
473	        self.cards.insert(id, card);
474	        self.name_to_id.insert(name, id);
475	        id
476	    }
477	
478	    /// Look up a card's behavior by ID.
479	    pub fn get(&self, id: CardId) -> Option<&dyn CardBehavior> {
480	        self.cards.get(&id).map(|b| b.as_ref())
481	    }
482	
483	    /// Look up a card ID by name.
484	    pub fn get_id_by_name(&self, name: &str) -> Option<CardId> {
485	        self.name_to_id.get(name).copied()
486	    }
487	
488	    /// Get card data by ID.
489	    pub fn card_data(&self, id: CardId) -> Option<CardData> {
490	        self.get(id).map(|b| b.card_data())
491	    }
492	
493	    /// Build a registry with all built-in cards.
494	    pub fn with_all_cards() -> Self {
495	        let mut reg = Self::new();
496	        // Lands
497	        reg.register(Box::new(forest::Forest));
498	        reg.register(Box::new(mountain::Mountain));
499	        reg.register(Box::new(plains::Plains));
500	        reg.register(Box::new(island::Island));
501	        reg.register(Box::new(swamp::Swamp));
